meta.description: Release a project outside the Monday cycle. Arena still owns generation, validation and publication; this workflow only says when, for which day, and how far to take it.

nodes.name: Someone asks for a release
nodes.notes: Header auth is required. This webhook can start a live participant-facing week, so an unauthenticated URL would be a public publish button. Configure the credential in n8n; Arena never sees it.

nodes.name: Tuesday 07:00 WIB
nodes.notes: Disabled by default. Enable only if a mid-week release becomes routine rather than exceptional — the Monday cycle stays the norm, and two unattended publishers competing for the same week is how duplicate releases happen.

nodes.name: Tell Arena to release it
nodes.notes: ARENA_ADMIN_TOKEN is INTERNAL_ADMIN_TOKEN, whose INTERNAL_ADMIN_SCOPES must include `projects`. It must not equal INTERNAL_AUTOMATION_TOKEN — Arena denies the request outright if they match. Five minutes because generation calls a model once per active division. neverError keeps a 4xx readable in the run log instead of aborting the branch.
